eyebrow: Detecting drift with a two-sample KS test
code:
from scipy.stats import ks_2samp
import numpy as np

training_feature = np.load("training_feature_distribution.npy")
production_feature = get_recent_production_values(
    feature="request_token_length", hours=24
)

statistic, p_value = ks_2samp(training_feature, production_feature)

if p_value < 0.01:
    log_drift_alert(feature="request_token_length", p_value=p_value)
caption: Run per-feature on a schedule against a rolling production window to quantify which feature moved, and how confidently.
